mapper.insert: insert into `order` (id, amount, name, create_by, status, create_time) values (#{order.id}, #{order.amount}, #{order.name}, #{order.createBy}, #{order.status}, #{order.createTime});
mapper.select: select * from `order` where create_by = #{userId} and status = #{status};
select SUM(goods.point * order_goods.goods_count) as total_points from goods right join order_goods on order_goods.goods_id = goods.id where order_goods.order_id = #{orderId};
select id, amount, name, status, create_time from `order` where create_by = #{userId} order by create_time desc limit #{size};
